attribution: Z-Anatomy - The libre 3D atlas of anatomy; BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science; additional model-specific credits in ATTRIBUTION.txt and meshes.json
modifications: Exact original named source Draco payloads, attributes, indices and materials retained. Thirty-seven whole cardiac surfaces receive the same flat-node translation [0,0.008,0] metres under new physical IDs. No source mesh deformation, remeshing, resampling, mirror or recompression. World bounds are separately updated. Original source dataset remains intact.
limitations: Partial gross anatomy: supplied source valve leaflets/papillary muscles are incomplete; no complete pericardium, chordal apparatus, conduction or cardiac innervation geometry is claimed.
Original erroneous Right AV valve aggregate is omitted because it includes a posterior LEFT AV leaflet.
Main pulmonary arterial and four venous source physical surfaces are included; distal lung branches remain outside this cardiac slice.
Ascending aorta, SVC and thoracic IVC require separately coordinated root accommodation before complete connected-body admission.
